description: This file defines the GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) controller for the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It handles displaying GDPR information, processing GDPR-related actions (such as export or remove data requests), and managing GDPR status updates via links. It also includes functions for serving success pages and validation of user requests.

classes.name: Gdpr
classes.description: Controller class for GDPR-related actions including viewing GDPR info, handling user requests, and confirming GDPR actions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays GDPR information page if available; otherwise returns a not found action.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Processes GDPR request actions such as export or remove, validates inputs, prevents spam, stores request data, and responds with JSON status.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Handles GDPR success confirmation based on a code, updates GDPR status, and displays a success message.
